Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the public health improvement account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to funding for public health improvement; amendingRCW 43.79.480; adding a new section to chapter 43.70 RCW; and creatinga new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that protecting thepublic's health is essential and that the threat of a pandemic outbreakof a disease is ongoing and growing. The legislature also finds thatthe public health system as defined in RCW 43.70.575 is essential tofulfilling the state's responsibility to protect the health and safetyof its citizens. The legislature further finds that local publichealth departments lack adequate resources even as their dutiesincrease. Rather than risk catastrophic loss of life, the legislaturefurther finds that local public health departments must immediately begiven the resources to effectively implement the specific public healthimprovement standards concerning threats to our drinking water and foodsupplies, communicable disease, and other firstresponder duties uniqueto local public health departments, pursuant to the requirements in RCW43.70.520.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The public health improvement account is created in the statetreasury. All receipts from strategic contribution payments receivedby the state of Washington in accordance with the settlement of thestate's legal action against tobacco product manufacturers shall bedeposited in the account. The legislature may make additionalappropriations to the account. Moneys in the account may be spent onlyafter appropriation. Expenditures from the account may be used to fundprograms and activities undertaken by the department of health, countypublic health departments, and public health districts to achieve thelocal public health standards adopted in the public health servicesimprovement plan pursuant to RCW 43.70.520(8).

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.79.480 and 2002 c 365 s 15 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Moneys received by the state of Washington in accordance withthe settlement of the state's legal action against tobacco productmanufacturers, exclusive of costs and attorneys' fees, shall bedeposited in the tobacco settlement account created in this sectionexcept as these moneys are sold or assigned under chapter 43.340 RCW. (2) The tobacco settlement account is created in the statetreasury. Moneys in the tobacco settlement account may only betransferred to the health services account for the purposes set forthin RCW 43.72.900, ((and)) to the tobacco prevention and control accountfor purposes set forth in this section, and to the public healthimprovement account established under section 2 of this act. (3) The tobacco prevention and control account is created in thestate treasury. The source of revenue for this account is moneystransferred to the account from the tobacco settlement account,investment earnings, donations to the account, and other revenues asdirected by law. Expenditures from the account are subject toappropriation.
